title: microsorum grossum
intro: Microsorum grossum, commonly known as Tung Saw, is a type of fern native to Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Microsorum grossum are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for various ailments. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
